title: helichrysum rupestre f. latifolium
intro: Helichrysum rupestre f. latifolium, commonly known as Mountain Everlast or Rock Helichrysum, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is prized for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum rupestre f. latifolium include analgesic, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
